steps.heading: Desktop Agent Connection
steps.description: Ensure the Numista Hardware Tray Agent ('numista_hardware') is running on your Windows PC and showing a connected status indicator.

steps.heading: Manual Focus Wheel Adjustment
steps.description: Slowly rotate the silver focus wheel on your Jiusion USB microscope until the live image sharpness peaks on screen. Auto-capture will automatically trigger when motion stability holds for 1.2 seconds.

steps.heading: External Side-Lighting Tip
steps.description: For high-luster coins like Morgan Dollars or American Silver Eagles, position an external light source at a 45-degree angle to eliminate harsh lens reflection and highlight die varieties.

csv_ingestion_tips.title: Zero-Reformatting Spreadsheet Upload
tips: No header editing required! Upload your Excel (.xlsx) or CSV files directly.
Informal coin shorthand (e.g. 'wheatie', 'walker', 'ike', 'merc', 'slick', 'DMPL') is automatically mapped to canonical US Mint series and Sheldon grades.
Custom columns like 'Price Paid' or 'Personal Notes' are mapped automatically into your private vault record.

estate_division_guide.title: Estate Partitioning & Beneficiary Locks
tips: Lock heirloom items to specific beneficiaries before running the lot division solver.
The Longest Processing Time (LPT) engine balances physical coin values across heirs and calculates exact dollar cash equalization offsets.
